description: Estimate cost of a TRON transaction BEFORE sending. Aliases: estimate_cost, calculate_cost, transaction_cost, energy_cost, transfer_cost. Calculate exactly how much energy, bandwidth, and TRX a TRON transaction will cost before sending it. Use this to answer questions like "how much does a USDT transfer cost?" or "what will it cost me to send 100 USDT to address X?". Returns: energy units needed, bandwidth needed, TRX cost if you burn directly, and TRX cost if you rent energy from Merx (typically 70-80% cheaper). Supports trc20_transfer (e.g. USDT/USDC), trc20_approve, trx_transfer, and custom contract calls. No auth required.
name: estimate_transaction_cost
